1. E-Mail und Passwort deines Miele-App-:
1. Enter your Miele app account email and password and click 'Sign in'.
2. Note: After login, the page will hang on a spinning loading wheel (or show an error). This is completely normal and indicates success!
1. Im Netzwerk-Tab (F12) ganz nach unten:
1. In the Network tab (F12), scroll to the very last (often red) request starting with 'redirect?redirect_uri=miele...' or 'miele://oauth2-code/...'.
2. Right-click that entry ➔ 'Copy URL' / 'Copy link address'.
3. Paste the URL into the field below and click 'Fetch GroupKey'.
1. Oben auf „Login-Seite öffnen“ klicken:
1. Click 'Open login page' above (a new browser tab opens).
2. In the new tab, press F12 and switch to the 'Network' tab.
3. Enable persistent logging:
   • Chrome / Edge / Brave: Check 'Preserve log'.
   • Firefox: Click gear ⚙️ ➔ check 'Persist Logs'.
Antwortet ein manuell eingetragenes Gerä: If a manually entered device stops answering, the adapter probes its own /24 network once (at most every 30 minutes). Needed when the appliances get their IP via DHCP and mDNS does not get through - for instance inside a Docker bridge network.
Bei Ausfall die neue IP im Subnetz suche: Search the subnet for the new IP if a device drops out
Der Adapter ermittelt die lokalen Zugang: The adapter retrieves local credentials (GroupID/GroupKey) once by signing in with your Miele account. The Miele app continues to work as before. No credentials are transmitted to third parties.
Der vom Gerät gemeldete Verbrauch ist ei: The consumption reported by the appliance is an estimate, not a measurement. If you have a metering plug in front of it, enter its meter state here.
Energie, Wasser und Dauer je Programm mi: Energy, water and duration per cycle, timestamped at the end of the cycle – so charts can cover any period.
Findet Geräte per mDNS im selben Netz. I: Finds appliances via mDNS on the same network. Multicast does not pass through a Docker bridge network – then enter the IP addresses below by hand.
Für Geräte, welche die Suche nicht finde: For appliances the scan does not find, and whenever multicast does not get through. One row per appliance.
Geräte melden Änderungen sofort, statt a: Appliances report changes immediately instead of being polled. Not every module can do this: older XKM accept the subscription but send nothing.
Instanz des Cloud-Adapters, aus der die: Instance of the cloud adapter the reference values come from, for example mielecloudservice.0.
Legt beschreibbare Datenpunkte an. Befeh: Creates writable states. Commands only take effect while MobileStart is enabled on the appliance; some firmwares reject them outright.
Legt die Datenpunkt-Namen zweisprachig a: Creates the state names bilingually; the admin then shows them in German. Takes effect after saving and restarting.
Legt die geräteinternen Werte als Datenp: Creates the appliance's internal values as states – heating relay, water level, drum speed and more. The field names come from public projects and are unverified.
Legt zwei Tabellen ab und öffnet die ers: Writes two tables and opens the first: one row per programme with all raw fields, plus an analysis with one row per field. Take care when sharing – the table contains the programme timestamps.
Liest Energie und Wasser per DOP2. Nur G: Reads energy and water via DOP2. Only appliances that provide it – so far washing machines.
Liest Rest- und Laufzeit sekundengenau p: Reads remaining and elapsed time to the second via DOP2 instead of only in minutes.
Muss aus dem Gerätenetz eingehend erreic: Must be reachable inbound from the appliance network. In a Docker container this reliably works only with network_mode: host.
Nach erfolgreicher Ermittlung stehen Gro: Once retrieved, GroupID and encrypted GroupKey appear on the 'Advanced' tab. Don't forget to save.
Nummer des Feldes im Eco-Leaf, das die E: Number of the field in the eco leaf that carries the energy. The default fits the WCR860; on other models determine it via the data collection.
Nummer des Feldes im Eco-Leaf, das die W: Number of the field in the eco leaf that carries the water volume. The default fits the WCR860; on other models determine it via the data collection.
Schreibt alle Felder des Eco-Leaf nach e: Writes all fields of the eco leaf to eco.felderJson instead of only the two evaluated ones. Helps when energy or water arrive wrong on your model.
Schreibt je Programm einen Datensatz mit: Records one dataset per programme with model, programme and all raw fields. From cloud values or your own entries the adapter derives the field mapping.
Schreibt jedes abgeschlossene Programm m: Records every completed programme. The appliances keep nothing – the history starts when you switch this on and cannot be filled retroactively.
Schritt 1: Auf „Login-Seite öffnen\" kli: Step 1: Click "Open login page" and sign in with your Miele account in the browser. At the end the browser tries to open an address of the form "miele://oauth2-code/?code=…&state=…". This complete address (the "code") is needed in step 2.
Schritt 3: Adresse kopieren & GroupKey e: Step 3: Copy redirect address & fetch GroupKey
Wie oft der Adapter fragt, solange kein: How often the adapter polls while no programme is running.
Wie oft der Adapter während eines laufen: How often the adapter polls while a programme is running.
Wie viele der letzten Programme in cycle: How many recent cycles are kept in cyclesJson. Meant for quick display; long-term data comes from the history adapter.
Wird normalerweise über die Anmeldung ge: Normally set through the login. Enter by hand only if GroupID and GroupKey are already known.
Wird verschlüsselt gespeichert und nie i: Stored encrypted and never shown in clear text.
Zusätzlich in den History-Adapter schrei: Also write to the history adapter
Ältere Einträge fallen aus dem Ringpuffe: Older entries drop out of the ring buffer. 730 days is two years.
